$comment: Game ideas as players pitch them, each labelled with the mechanics it needs (src/gap.ts names them). The mechanic-gap report weighs them against the systems catalog: what the platform can build now, and what to build next.

ideas.prompt: A cave platformer where a mole collects gems and stomps beetles.
A knight clearing a crypt room by room, sword in hand, a boss at the bottom.
Hold out against a zombie horde for five minutes, levelling up your weapons.
A spaceship shooter through asteroid belts with power-ups.
A farm where you grow pumpkins, sell them and buy better seeds.
Push boxes onto switches in an ice palace.
Explore a sunken castle, find the double jump and the key to the throne room.
A racing game on a winding desert track against three rivals, three laps.
A fishing game at a lake: cast, wait for a bite, reel in, sell the catch for a better rod.
Tower defense: place cannons along the road to stop waves of goblins reaching the castle.
A stealth game where a cat sneaks past sleeping guards to steal the fish.
Talk to villagers to find the lost dog, then lead it home.
A rhythm game where you jump on the beat across a neon city.
A card battler: draw a hand, play attack and block cards against a dragon.
An endless runner on rooftops dodging chimneys, faster and faster.
Flappy-style: a bird flaps through gaps in bamboo.
A restaurant rush: take orders, carry dishes to tables before customers leave.
Survive on an island: gather wood, craft an axe, build a shelter before night.
A bullet-hell boss rush against five giant mechs.
A dungeon crawler with keys, locked doors, slimes and treasure chests.
A twin-stick shooter in an arena of robots.
Mine downward for gold and gems, sell them, upgrade the drill.
A snake game where the snake grows with every apple.
Breakout with a twist: the bricks are clouds and the ball is a sun.
A match-three garden where matching flowers grows a tree.
Golf on floating islands: aim, set power, sink the ball.
A hero with a grappling hook swinging between clock towers.
A pet shelter: feed and play with puppies until each finds a home.
Collect all the stars in a maze before the ghosts catch you.
A turn-based tactics skirmish of four knights against orcs on a grid.
A lighthouse keeper who keeps the lamp lit through a stormy night, fetching oil from the cellar.
A metroidvania in a haunted library: find the lantern to see in the dark wing.
Bees defending the hive against wasp swarms until dawn.
A courier on a bike delivering parcels across town before the timer runs out.
A space trader buying cheap ore and selling it dear between three stations.
A wizard duel: cast fireballs and shields, read the opponent's spell.
An ice skating game: carve figures on the rink before the music ends.
A ninja platformer with wall jumps and throwing stars.
Herd sheep into the pen before the wolves arrive.
A cooking game: chop, cook and plate three dishes in order.
A city of mushrooms: place houses and wells so every house has water.
A detective who questions suspects and points out the culprit.
Dodge falling meteors as long as you can.
Ride a dragon through canyons, breathing fire at knights.
A sokoban in a bakery: slide trays of bread into the ovens.
Platform through a candy world, eating sweets and avoiding gumdrop monsters.
A shepherd of stars catching falling stars in a basket.
An orchard where apples ripen over days; bake pies to sell at market.
A pirate ship sinking enemy ships with broadside cannons.
A tank battle in a maze, bouncing shells off walls.
Clear the haunted mansion of ghosts with a flashlight.
Ski down a mountain dodging trees and passing through flags.
A frog crossing busy roads and rivers to reach the lily pads.
Build a bridge with limited planks so the cart can cross.
A roguelike: random floors, pick one of three upgrades after each, permadeath.
A slime that splits when hit; clear the arena of every slime.
Hide and seek: find all five hidden kittens in the garden before sunset.
Guide a robot by placing arrows on the floor so it reaches the battery.
A gardener defending tomatoes from moles that pop up: bonk them with a mallet.
A volcano escape: climb up as the lava rises.
